_about: LIVE MACHINE ENUMERATION EVIDENCE. One file per production block, never merged.
Generated from the operator's consolidated IO v1.7.7 handoff, which is AUTHORITATIVE over
historical or public recipe data wherever they conflict.
Build times are preserved verbatim as displayed strings, including ranges.
output_qty is recorded ONLY where the UI showed one (e.g. '10x Lightbulb'); a single
result icon is not evidence of yield.
Physical subtype ids are NEVER inferred from display names. identity_hint is null where
unproven, and identity_confidence records the doubt or the conflict explicitly.
See machine_evidence/README.md for the full transcription rules.
